summary: Tested the new Rx Void / Archive soft-delete feature end-to-end on Preview. 4/4 backend pytest cases pass (physician 403, staff void success + data preserved, admin void success, voided items still exist via ?status=voided). Frontend UI verified: staff sees Void / Archive control with void-reason select + Void Request button; after voiding, record hidden from active queue; visible under 'Voided / Archived' filter with voided-banner showing reason, voided_by, voided_at; medication_name, ref_number, patient_name intact; act-void hidden for voided records.

issues: Action buttons (Send to Physician, Mark Completed, Appointment Required, Book Appointment) plus 'Add internal note' textarea remain visible and clickable on voided records. Spec states voided record should be 'preserved read-only'. Backend does not prevent these actions from being applied to a voided document, which could allow a voided item to be resurrected via 'Send to Physician' etc. Consider hiding standard action buttons when internal_status === 'voided', and/or rejecting non-'void' actions server-side when current status is 'voided'.

action_items: Optional: Hide non-void action buttons and internal-note input on voided Rx items in RxQueue detail modal (Queue.jsx); backend could also reject actions when internal_status is already 'voided' to enforce read-only semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1113-1121 (void handler): correctly gates on role in (staff, admin) with 403 for physician; sets internal_status='voided', voided_by, voided_at, void_reason, completed_at; no notify_patient call — matches spec.

server.py L1137-1148 (rx_queue): default query correctly uses internal_status $nin ['voided']; status query param bypasses exclusion so ?status=voided works. Physician branch limited to waiting_physician — good.
No hard delete anywhere in the void path — record is preserved. Verified via API.
UI: RxQueue.jsx voided-banner (L119-124) renders reason/voided_by/voided_at properly; Queue.jsx L164-181 correctly guards void control on role and non-voided status.
Minor: voided items still show forward-action buttons in detail modal (allowing e.g. Mark Completed on a voided item) — inconsistent with read-only intent.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Rx Void feature fully working. If main agent tightens read-only enforcement on voided items, retest that voided records can no longer be modified via non-void actions (server returns 4xx) and that action buttons are hidden in UI when internal_status === 'voided'.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified. Only observation is a minor UX gap where voided items still expose forward-workflow actions.
